hypothesis: A directional reversal body with a strong directional close, engulfing body, or previous-range recovery may reject weak BB mean-reversion entries. Reject this hypothesis if the fixed net-win-rate improvement and profitability gates fail.
baseline: Current BB3 min-center 3 pips, simulate_center mode unchanged
entry_rules: BB20 3sigma preparation and prior contextual/wick exclusions unchanged. First otherwise eligible confirmed baseline signal with signed center distance >=3 pips tests its shape; failure cancels preparation and prevents same-bar rearming, never waits. Pass enters next available open. BUY/SELL exact symmetry. Zero-range and doji reject all shape filters. At most one position per symbol.

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: not fixed: existing user BB moving-center exit retained, not a new RR strategy
exit_rules.target: previous confirmed SMA20, open-gap target first, then intrabar target; target advances only after fill checks

period_convention: inclusive start, exclusive end; flat restart per period; indicators warm from 2023-08-01; no positions carried between partitions
final_period_prior_exposure: Previously viewed BB study/descriptive results; NOT untouched holdout. No new candle-study validation outcomes viewed during development.

search_space.name: body_engulf
search_space.rule: directional body; previous body strictly opposite; current body fully contains previous body inclusive boundaries

search_space.name: previous_range_reclaim
search_space.rule: directional body and BUY close>previous high / SELL close<previous low

directional_close_location: BUY (close-low)/(high-low); SELL (high-close)/(high-low). All shape thresholds exact inclusive, except directional body and previous-range reclaim strict.

cost_and_fill_model.fees: included in fixed total; not symbol-specific observed costs
cost_and_fill_model.fill: next available open, no synthetic stop, same-bar target permitted
cost_and_fill_model.source_price: Bars.dat stored OHLC; timezone unknown, no time-of-day rules

position_sizing_and_currency: Equal-pip score, not monetary portfolio P/L; no compounding or account capital specified
cross_symbol_rule: At least5 of8 pairs closed net>0 at each cost; same candidate shared by all symbols
selection: Train all4 once. Eligible candidate ranked cost1.4 winrate descending, PF descending, id ascending; maximum1 goes to validation. No eligible: stop. Validation fail: stop before final. No fallback or retuning. Later gates retain relative count and gain, absolute minimum50.
risk_reporting: Report closed PF/net, open P/L, combined net+open, per-pair bar-close MTM drawdown, holding times. No SL means unbounded adverse excursions; win rate alone not adoption.
